policy: A construction or decanting phase is transition_ready only when all declared mandatory services remain adequate for every affected group over the full cutover interval, supported by current owner receipts and any temporary substitute qualification. Unknown or stale intervals never count as adequate.

expected.claim_ceiling: synthetic phase-transition continuity mechanics only; not actual service continuity, lawful decanting, professional approval, construction safety or resident wellbeing
